Hardware probe + autonomous adaptive GPU OCR
sysprobe scans OS/Python/CPU/RAM/GPU/laptop+battery -> resource profile; run_ocr_auto.bat probes, installs the
GPU stack (PP-OCRv5 + v4 fallback), runs to 100% unattended (self-restarting), reports. Tuned to RTX 4050: 8
Complete feature compatibility Win11 down to Win7/Vista via per-OS engine substitution (PyMuPDF<->Poppler,
RapidOCR<->Tesseract; stdlib core). Only GPU acceleration is Win10+ - a speed booster, not a feature.
